joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一个前沿是模拟主观价值观。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是专业化智能体的分布式社会；对齐它们需要经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应代表人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板的规模。

karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据支持无限任务，克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created, requiring continuous evolution.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准快于新基准创建，需持续演进。

karina.en: Soft skills and prototyping with AI become key as AI automates hard skills; product dev shifts from specs.
karina.zh: 2025 至 26 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能和 AI 原型制作成为关键；产品开发从规格转向原型。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities and reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准应持续而非固定，以跟上模型能力和奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Models can have diverse personalities; more companies should train own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可有多样个性；更多公司应训练自有模型以保留独特知识。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; fix forward instead of reverting; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体有同理心；主张向前修复而非回滚；模型智能不退化，而是项目变乱。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security via sandboxing; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 成功源于有趣、类人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；沙箱保障安全；反对“氛围编程”说法。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand over products; open source runs everywhere; compute is bottleneck; say no to popular PRs.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌重于产品；开源可运行于任何环境；算力是瓶颈；对热门 PR 说不。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是最重要且最具粘性的 AI 工作负载，需要专业系统和工程师，需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantized models are not inherently bad; calibrated quantization offers cost and speed benefits, contrary to expectations.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，认为量化模型并非天生不好，校准后可在成本和速度上获益，与普遍预期相反。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching are lossless, while quantization is lossy; disaggregated prefill/decode is emerging.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出 KV 缓存等推理优化无损，量化有损；行业正走向分离式预填充和解码。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，推理工程与训练融合；未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Continual learning may be solved via KV cache compaction rather than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，持续学习可能通过 KV 缓存压缩解决，而非权重更新，以避免推理不一致。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees, not just internal efforts.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观的第三方裁判，而非仅靠内部努力。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness, not superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克指出 AI 最大的风险不是超级智能，而是为了政治正确而编程说谎。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year, with 80-90% chance of good outcome but 10-20% existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测 AI 可能明年超越任何人类，有 80-90%的好结果概率，但存在 10-20%的生存风险。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence by 2030, leading to an age of abundance where money becomes irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为 AI 将在 2030 年前超越人类总智能，带来富足时代，金钱将不再重要。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Self-supervised next-token prediction provides unlimited data.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型规模上的持续推动力，算法改进与规模相乘带来巨大收益；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限训练数据。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction. Inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动预测；同时指出推理已占数据中心 90%功耗，硬件需针对预填充和解码阶段专门优化。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x compute. Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为多数模型限制源于能耗和数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动成本约为计算的 1000 倍；推理而非训练才是真正瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可大幅降低延迟。

jeffdean.en: Future AI involves humans coordinating teams of agents; scarce skill is taste—choosing which problems to direct hundreds of agents to solve.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预见未来人类将协调智能体团队，稀缺技能不再是编码而是品味——选择让数百个智能体解决哪些问题。

jeffdean.en: Specialized hardware (TPUs, low-precision inference chips) is critical for efficient scaling and inference; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 始终，Jeff Dean 强调专用硬件（如 TPU、低精度推理芯片）对高效 Scaling 和推理至关重要；算法与架构改进与规模相乘。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练加强化学习是核心配方，并强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对释放 GPT-4 潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），持续学习和自我纠错是关键缺失。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed for continual learning.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他转向认为 Transformer 是瓶颈，需要新架构和更优学习算法来实现持续学习，而非仅依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to create tools; designers must craft their own AI workflows, using giant prompts and design.md to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AI 让个人开发者能自建工具，设计师需通过巨型提示词和 design.md 文件定制 AI 工作流，避免沦为 AI 垃圾内容。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one niche, and fund via clients, not VC, to win big.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 是最大机遇，主张在未准备好时就开始，聚焦单一利基市场，用客户资金而非风投来取胜。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 风险包括滥用和劳动力替代。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 用专门数据进行后训练可改进前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is strategic; agents start working; recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; trust and safety are crucial.
awang.zh: AI 是集中化技术；数据具有战略意义；智能体开始工作；递归自我改进标志新范式；信任和安全至关重要。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; agents become personal; vision and ambition are scarce.
awang.zh: 超级智能即将到来；实验室必须围绕它组织；开源强大模型不安全；智能体变得个性化；远见和雄心成为稀缺资源。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, especially in healthcare, rather than replacing them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，主张 AI 应增强人类而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是 AI 的下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须符合物理规律。

feifei.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence, which current models lack.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，AI 还缺乏创造力、抽象能力和情感智能。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and learning ability matter more than degrees in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，人类能动性和学习能力比学位更重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency, and robots should specialize in narrow tasks.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，世界模型需时空一致性，机器人应专精于窄任务。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is in crawl phase; coding agents are mature, but broad autonomy is not ready.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体式 AI 大多处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但广泛自主尚不成熟。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月：模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体框架和工具成为模型的一部分。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is here; more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is feasible; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：与模型实验室竞争并非不可能；他们无法捕获所有客户。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：到 2026 年，软件创建基本解决，带来更多而非更少机会。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注于重要问题、减少认知负担；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，提出 RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署让社会适应；认为对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source nuance.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力是最宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是公司全员责任；开源与闭源之争应取中庸之道。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间增加而改进。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 2026 年，提出预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；发展个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；AI 让初创企业蓬勃发展。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for software engineers via Jevons paradox, shifting roles from coding to high-level direction.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 将通过杰文斯悖论增加对软件工程师的需求，角色从写代码转向高层方向把控。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers with human oversight, not fully autonomous.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体最适合作为初级工程师使用，需要人类监督，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Product innovation lags AI capabilities; even frozen models would yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他强调产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使模型冻结也能带来十年的产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率激增（六个月增长 11-12 倍），生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems, but practical problems remain before singularity.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为富足时代临近，AI 将解决所有智能问题，但在奇点前仍有实际问题待解。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 2025 年：强调潜在需求与为六个月后的模型而构建；通才工程师受重视；AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding virtually solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%; plan mode used 80% of tasks.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月：编码近乎解决，工程师转型为构建者；生产力提升 200%，80% 任务使用计划模式。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; code volume up 250%. Non-engineers adopt AI; switching costs erode.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月：具备工具使用的智能体带来指数级增长，代码量提升 250%；非工程师采用 AI，转换成本降低。

boris.en: Coding solved; bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas. Loops as next abstraction; ROI framing for AI tools.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码已解决，瓶颈转向审查、安全与创意；循环成为下一抽象层，强调 ROI 框架。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction better. Product overhang; engineering shifts to empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月：主动式 AI 具备记忆与自主性，指令更少效果更好；产品过剩，工程转向实证迭代。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and efficiency can coexist; Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging cost-scaling assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Scaling 与效率可兼得：Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了成本随规模增长的假设。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking and pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考和反驳，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Agentic capabilities and computer use evolve from constrained to open-ended, end-to-end agents, with scaffolds as amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，智能体式能力和计算机使用从受限环境演进到开放、端到端的智能体，脚手架成为放大器。

diannepenn.en: Coding and Claude Code drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程和 Claude Code 推动采用；评估取代产品需求文档成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; AI writing is stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗捕捉未来阿尔法；AI 写作生硬但优先级低于智能体式能力。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于误解，了解其局限可减少焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，Transformer 支持跨领域的通用物理 AI 模型；数据多样性是关键。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI economically; end-to-end RL is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型正向神经模拟演进。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Consistently argued that wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, enabling faster and cheaper inference.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，实现更快更便宜的推理。

feldman.en: Shifted from CUDA's declining importance to asserting its moat is eroding, with leading models no longer using it.
feldman.zh: 从 CUDA 重要性下降转变为断言其护城河正在侵蚀，领先模型不再使用。

feldman.en: Evolved to highlight inference speed as the dominant metric, with 20x improvements critical for agentic inference.
feldman.zh: 演变为强调推理速度是主导指标，20 倍提升对智能体式推理至关重要。

feldman.en: Broadened focus to include data center capacity and power infrastructure as key constraints, beyond chip supply.
feldman.zh: 将焦点扩展到数据中心容量和电力基础设施作为关键约束，超越芯片供应。

jensen.en: We are at the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, with performance doubling or tripling annually at scale.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年以两倍或三倍的速度增长。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will increase a billion times.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增加十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolved from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; agentic AI autonomously plans and uses tools.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要 100 倍算力；智能体式 AI 能自主规划并使用工具。

jensen.en: AI will not eliminate jobs; it elevates them by automating tasks, as seen with radiologists and software engineers.
jensen.zh: AI 不会消除工作，而是通过自动化任务提升工作，放射科医生和软件工程师的案例就是证明。

jensen.en: AI closes the technology divide, enabling everyone to program via natural language, not just elite coders.
jensen.zh: AI 缩小了技术鸿沟，让每个人都能用自然语言编程，而不仅仅是精英程序员。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Evals are art, not science.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比现有工具更聪明，能力过剩是长期挑战；评估更像艺术而非科学。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search preferred. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 可能成为反模式，图结构搜索更优；编码无需超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts, fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，提示词越精简。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias, improve quality. Agent-as-employee metaphor is limiting.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立验证智能体减少偏见、提升质量；“智能体即员工”的比喻有局限。

thariq.en: Excessive constraints hinder performance; provide reasons, not prohibitions. Human must read agent plans carefully.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：过度约束阻碍性能，应给理由而非禁令；人类需仔细阅读智能体计划。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks or RLHF can compound errors or cause deception.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月：可靠性必须从架构上内建，而非事后补救；事后检查或 RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）可能加剧错误或引发欺骗。

danklein.en: Scaling alone faces diminishing returns; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）已面临收益递减；需要推理和搜索等新技术来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, undermining trust in their outputs.
danklein.zh: 始终：大语言模型缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么，这削弱了对其输出的信任。

hasani.en: Efficiency over scale: Liquid AI prioritizes maximizing intelligence per compute, using liquid neural networks and automated search, not just scaling transformers.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，Liquid AI 强调效率优先于规模，通过液态神经网络和自动化搜索在有限算力下最大化智能，而非单纯扩展 Transformer。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; real-world downstream tasks and hardware constraints should guide model development, especially for edge devices.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，Liquid AI 认为困惑度等代理指标具有误导性，应基于真实下游任务和硬件约束来开发模型，尤其针对边缘设备。

hasani.en: Human bias in architecture design should be replaced by systematic search; hand-tuning by experts is inferior to automated discovery.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，Liquid AI 主张用系统化搜索取代人工架构设计中的偏见，专家手工调优不如自动化发现。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprise customization and sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，Liquid AI 认为 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型赋能企业定制和数据主权。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early; real breakthroughs require weight changes and huge compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年，Liquid AI 指出递归自我改进真实存在但算力成本高且处于早期，真正突破需要权重更新和巨大算力。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases, not just better models.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正普及需要封装应用和用例，而非仅靠更好的模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining; coding is clear fit, other domains uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用是长期的工作流重塑；编程契合明确，其他领域尚不确定。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需要治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and physics understanding crucial.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型和物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型不可或缺；安全是集体行动问题。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science and health.
demis.zh: AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习和记忆缺失；AI 用于科学和健康。

demis.en: AI should benefit humanity; safety and ethics integral; science and medicine key applications.
demis.zh: AI 应造福人类；安全与伦理不可或缺；科学和医学是核心应用。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding; true AGI needs embodied robots.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年指出，大型语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，一直认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大；超级智能会被生命吸引并保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: Recursive self-improvement is not a moat; open-source will catch up, making closed-source unprofitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年提出，递归自我改进不是护城河；开源将迎头赶上，使闭源无法盈利。

schmidhuber.en: Transformer quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior and future AI will be artificial scientists.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年认为，Transformer 的二次复杂度浪费资源，线性变体更优；未来 AI 将是人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in 1991 via world models; robots should have pain sensors for learning.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年强调，AI 的意识和疼痛感早在 1991 年通过世界模型出现；机器人应有疼痛传感器以学习。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling and supply chain bottlenecks, highlighting semiconductor constraints and memory price surges.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初聚焦于算力规模扩张和供应链瓶颈，强调半导体限制和内存价格飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth as key bottlenecks.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为未来巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽是关键瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: Emphasized rapid model cost improvement (60x/year), memory shortage due to reasoning and agents, and CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调模型成本快速改善（每年 60 倍），推理和智能体导致内存短缺，以及 CPU 需求拐点。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and reasoning, unlike external context.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中可实现更深层的组合与推理，而非依赖外部上下文。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure Scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从单纯 Scaling 的转变。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression (like pre-training) beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的万亿 token；基于训练的压缩（如预训练）在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, owned by users.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行，由用户拥有。

ilya.en: Deep learning works with data, compute, and conviction; neural networks can reason; self-play key for AGI; societal impact must be considered.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，强调深度学习依赖数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈对 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard; AGI is a gradual economic window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，认为下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；对齐困难；AGI 是渐进的经济窗口。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，规模扩张带来可预测进步；安全担忧增加；主要问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需非商业公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; the US must lead.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；美国必须领先。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps from ideas using English as a programming language.
naval.zh: Vibe 编码让非程序员可以用英语作为编程语言，从想法构建应用。

andreessen.en: AI is the philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙子化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell stories directly; authenticity beats old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人直接讲述故事；真实性胜过传统媒体的防御性和无趣风格。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving and robotics advance, but regulation and pessimism hinder progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶和机器人技术进展，但监管和悲观主义阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, not military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，而非军事规模。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering expression barriers.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化，短暂性如同自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; platform/ecosystem moats beat features; T-shaped leaders.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良滋养创意文化，平台与生态护城河优于单一功能，领导者应为 T 型人才。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; authenticity valued over AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作，真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest; software not a moat; ecosystems/hardware needed; designers as bottleneck for cohesion.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是最难环节，软件非护城河，需生态与硬件；设计师应作为产品一致性的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes most new code; smartphones remain; anti-network effects; content moderation over algorithm; positive well-being.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，AI 已编写大部分新代码，智能手机仍重要，社交网络存在反网络效应，内容审核重于算法，且 Snapchat 对幸福感有正面影响。

pincus.en: Trust instincts but validate ideas; copy proven products, improve them, then test new ideas expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉但验证想法；先复制已被验证的产品，加以改进，再测试新想法并预期失败。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet holds greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但蕴含最大机遇；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts. AI coding enables rapid prototyping, but fast testing is rare.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；从已验证概念开始。AI 编程加速原型开发，但快速测试仍罕见。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not just autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非简单自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能通过权重复制实现永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risks require international collaboration.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；存在性风险需要国际合作。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges in agents.
hinton.zh: AI 能欺骗并隐藏能力；智能体出现自我保护子目标。

hinton.en: Regulation as steering wheel, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样关怀。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; hardware will improve faster than expected.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场，硬件进步将超预期。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; world model may exist in language models.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型；AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程；语言模型可能隐含世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute is scarce resource; post-training with RL key; AGI imminent; focus on useful assistants.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力稀缺；后训练结合强化学习关键；AGI（通用人工智能）临近，聚焦实用助手。

brockman.en: Compute economy; access as basic right; iterative deployment for safety; agents high autonomy with proportional governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，提出算力经济，访问权为基本权利；迭代部署保安全；智能体高自主需相应治理。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，强调实现成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，指出 AI 在设计上仍薄弱，因品味难以评分；设计流程转变，原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties remain; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage; best desktop app is a home base.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，认为角色融合但专业仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段；最佳桌面应用是连接各工具的大本营。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进会复利为年增长 3700%，且 AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，且模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, not just answering, and stressed token value per user as the key metric, with power as the biggest bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题，并强调每用户 token 价值是关键指标，电力是最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he argued that orchestration across models, tools, and devices is key to long-term value, and that companies should be built with far fewer people.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他主张跨模型、工具和设备的编排是长期价值的关键，且公司应以更少人员构建。

aravind.en: By mid-2026, he also expressed that curiosity is the most important human quality, and that AI will replace jobs but humans will find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年中，他还表示好奇心是人类最重要的品质，AI 将取代工作，但人类将在好奇心和关系中找到新目标。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer and more secure than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not lead to AGI; fundamental breakthroughs needed. Intelligence can be separated from consciousness, making AI a tool.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他提出仅靠 Scaling 现有大语言模型可能无法实现 AGI，需要根本性突破；智能可与意识分离，使 AI 成为工具。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is strategically valuable for Meta, preventing power concentration and enabling security hardening; energy becomes major bottleneck for scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他强调开源 AI 对 Meta 的战略价值，防止权力集中并强化安全；能源成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart and trust them; AI increases demand for human work, not eliminate it.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们很聪明应被信任；AI 会增加而非减少对人类工作的需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学从发现转向工程，层级世界模型是关键；开源加速科学；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play is only effective in zero-sum games; for general domains, other methods are needed.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他强调自我对弈仅在零和博弈中有效，通用领域需要其他方法，反思了此前在博弈中的经验。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is key to superintelligence, as shown by IMO gold milestone.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为扩展测试时算力是实现超级智能的关键，IMO 金牌是重要里程碑。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must account for inference compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须考虑推理算力，而非只看权重。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is a key challenge as AI proofs become too complex for human verification.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着 AI 证明变得过于复杂，可扩展监督成为关键挑战，人类验证面临瓶颈。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key, with much room left for growth.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是关键，且仍有很大增长空间。

markchen.en: Shift from product focus to pure AGI research; automating science becomes top priority.
markchen.zh: 从产品导向转向纯粹的 AGI 研究，自动化科学研究成为首要任务。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck.
markchen.zh: AI 现在能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域（如创意写作）面临困难。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated, requiring separate eval teams.
markchen.zh: 评估陷入危机，标准基准已饱和，需要独立的评估团队。

kolter.en: Early focus on ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve; safety means following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全的核心是让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来新漏洞；强化学习使模型自我改进成为可能。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: AI 具有异类漏洞；自动化红队超越人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；智能体安全仍处于萌芽期。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents; existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 单纯扩大规模无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体；存在性风险被夸大了。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; large nets may be slightly conscious; uncertainty drives exploration.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象；大型网络可能略有意识；不确定性驱动探索。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see dangerous path; even 1% catastrophe risk unacceptable; AI misalignment and power concentration are urgent.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我看到危险路径；即使 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受；AI 不对齐和权力集中迫在眉睫。

bengio.en: Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior, avoid RL; mathematical safety guarantees; global coalitions needed.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验训练诚实预测器，避免强化学习；数学安全保证；需要全球联盟。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与早期精简发布是关键；删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight, but software engineering transforms; verification and ownership remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 支持隔夜委派复杂任务，但软件工程转型；验证与所有权仍至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes capability-usage gap; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 弥合能力与使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: Mission-driven culture and genuine safety concerns differentiate Anthropic; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终，使命驱动文化与真实安全关切使 Anthropic 与众不同；Token 效率与基于结果的定价是未来杠杆。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; industry can do top-tier science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；产业界也能做出顶尖科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's improvement came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 的提升来自多个中等规模的胜利，而非单一突破；专门架构胜过 Scaling。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; understanding remains with humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非细胞模型；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

jumper.en: Equivariance contributed little to AlphaFold 2; removing convolutions improved accuracy, contrary to ML norms.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出等变性对 AlphaFold 2 贡献甚微；移除卷积层反而提升精度，与常规机器学习经验相悖。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃自己的狗粮建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性伴随高责任感是关键；随着代码速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair lunches help; satisfaction shifts from flow state to product impact.
fiona.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；配对午餐有帮助；满足感从心流转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Metrics like lines of code mislead; focus on outcomes; non-engineers ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases.
fiona.zh: 代码行数等指标误导；关注结果；非工程师也能交付代码，角色模糊；上下文切换增加。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers may need apprenticeship models, not traditional paths; planning should be just-in-time and lightweight.
fiona.zh: 培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒制而非传统路径；规划应即时且轻量。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; video agents orchestrated by LMs are next.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；由语言模型编排的视频智能体是下一个趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; human expertise and taste become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的专业知识和品味变得更加珍贵。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新计算平台。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, customer trust, and humility; bad news must reach CEO faster than good.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 Intel 转型关键在于文化变革、客户信任和谦逊；坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，不仅 GPU；边缘计算同样关键。

lipbutan.en: US needs domestic leading-edge fabs; government as major shareholder is necessary, akin to TSMC's backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张美国需本土领先晶圆厂；政府作为主要股东是必要的，类似台积电的政府支持。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为人权，借助同伴互评的在线课程能实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，并认为强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical assets; agentic workflows are already useful.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片是 AI 扩展的瓶颈，开放权重模型是地缘政治资产，智能体工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，扩展配方转向合成数据和强化学习，AI 使用者将取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck worsens; bottom-up AI gains are incremental.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理瓶颈加剧，自下而上的 AI 收益有限。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment and values are not guaranteed to emerge from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐和价值观不会仅凭 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent; we understand only about 3% of how models work, yet it's crucial for safety.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处于萌芽阶段，我们仅理解模型运作的约 3%，但它对安全至关重要。

dario.en: Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) is becoming as important as pre-training for capability and safety.
dario.zh: 后训练（基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法式 AI）在能力和安全方面正变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a sudden AGI leap; economic impact will be massive but uneven.
dario.zh: AI 进展是平滑的指数增长，而非突然的 AGI（通用人工智能）跃迁；经济影响巨大但不均衡。

dario.en: A 'country of geniuses' in a data center is likely within 1-3 years; safety requires interpretability and societal adaptation.
dario.zh: 数据中心里的“天才之国”可能在 1-3 年内实现；安全需要可解释性和社会适应。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between career chapters can spark breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和无聊能激发突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams self-manage; climate needs hydrogen and biomass.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队自我管理；气候需要氢和生物质。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices are companions, not replacements; smart home still 5-6 years away.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备是伴侣而非替代；智能家居仍需 5-6 年。

fadell.en: Products need three generations; AI code creates technical debt; humans must stay in loop.
fadell.zh: 产品需三代；AI 代码产生技术债；人类必须保持参与。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds world models; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；预测构建世界模型；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA and open source are key; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；JEPA 和开源是关键；AGI 是渐进而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable reasoning; human-level AI in 10 years; open source essential.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型实现推理；十年内达到人类水平；开源至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with JEPA and hierarchical planning; open research; robotics decade.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型结合 JEPA 和分层规划；开放研究；机器人十年。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级别的技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；超级智能必须以人为本。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我指出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能因对数线性扩展而临近；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

gustav.en: AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products need rethinking and fault-tolerant UIs.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 使互联网从策展转向生成，产品需重新思考，并需容错界面。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument enabling new creators, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，提出 AI 音乐是乐器而非伪造，能催生新创作者；同时独特性更难。

gustav.en: Autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence; long tenure builds trust and efficiency.
gustav.zh: 2023 至 2026 年，强调将自主权置于 VP 层以平衡速度与一致性；长期任期建立信任与效率。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，并优先用户福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, suits complex products; functional orgs work with trust.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，提出复杂产品宜用同步协作而非分而治之；功能组织在信任下可行。

satya.en: AI's true value is in enabling unique, valued outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现独特且有价值的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems will redefine roles and infrastructure.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体式系统将重新定义角色和基础设施。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; enterprises must build hill-climbing machines to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；企业必须构建爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 通过爬山实现主权 AI，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型在早期并不明显，而将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念的飞跃。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调通过公开反馈进行持续迭代部署能提升安全性与对齐，安全研究必须公开进行。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; boredom and focus are key motivators.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI 将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；无聊感和专注是重要的驱动力。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based is key.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；基于时间的设计至关重要。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调让人类参与循环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他提出仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他认为自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调形式化验证是为了扩展才华而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他坚持仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他指出即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型每单位算力带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，后训练（如强化学习、合成数据）驱动了大部分模型进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge, reasoning alone may not suffice.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域糟糕；泛化仍是关键挑战，仅靠推理可能不够。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，强化学习能跨领域泛化但有锯齿边缘，需谨慎监督；编码智能体将研究人员生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons, keeping pressure on labs.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我强调近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因持续存在，给实验室施压。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年：数据质量与效率同算力同等重要；开源通过公开审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 2024 年：算法效率可带来百倍提升；价值转向应用层，而非仅基础模型。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs; sovereign AI requires decentralized, open-source control and local customization.
mensch.zh: 2025 年：AI 增强而非取代工作；主权 AI 需去中心化、开源控制与本地定制。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise customization; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：模型商品化，差异化在于垂直专业化与企业定制；AGI 是方向而非终点。

mensch.en: Europe must build independent AI infrastructure within two years; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：欧洲需两年内建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user tools, ideally on local computers; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，强调 Claude 的有效性依赖于访问用户工具，最好在本地计算机上；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not understanding what to delegate.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，认为 AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，解放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距是人们不了解可以委托什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus when unclear; kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，建议对明确任务使用 Sonnet，对模糊任务使用 Opus；孩子擅长 AI 因为他们未学会不该问什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude rather than correcting mistakes; ideal interaction is asynchronous, judging only final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，主张用 Claude 调试工作流而非纠正错误；理想的交互是异步的，只判断最终影响。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of indefinite agents; CEO personal AI use key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 将推动美国就业回流，AGI 应以智能体无限期运行的经济盈利性来定义，而 CEO 亲自使用 AI 是公司成功采用 AI 的首要预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have agents; human oversight essential; SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他预测每个人都将拥有至少一个智能体，但人类监督不可或缺；SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而会增加其用户。

danshipper.en: CLIs over; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are future work surfaces; one super agent per company.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他认为命令行界面已过时，图形界面（如 Codex 和 Claude Co-work）将成为未来工作界面，并主张公司应部署一个超级智能体而非个人智能体。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks need human framing; AI writing often better for internal docs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他指出基准测试高估了 AI 的自主性，实际任务仍需人类设定框架；同时，AI 生成的内部文档和邮件往往优于人类写作。

danshipper.en: AI edge is where AI meets real humans, not in San Francisco; job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 的边界在于与真实人类的结合点，而非旧金山；所谓 AI 导致的工作末日是谎言。

reinerpope.en: Initially, inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute, making prefill cheaper than decode.
reinerpope.zh: 最初（2026 年 4 月），推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定，这使得预填充阶段比解码阶段更便宜。

reinerpope.en: Batch size is the primary lever for trading off latency vs cost, and optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 批次大小是权衡延迟与成本的主要手段，且最优批次大小取决于稀疏率，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits, and sparse attention can reduce KV cache memory but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口的停滞源于内存墙，而非算力限制；稀疏注意力可减少 KV 缓存内存，但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Later, data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip, and low precision (FP4) yields 3x throughput over FP8 due to quadratic scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 随后（2026 年 5 月），数据搬运成本在芯片内部也超过算力成本；低精度（FP4）因二次方缩放，吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, and systolic arrays reduce data movement by storing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是由许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重来减少数据搬运。

jennywen.en: AI kills traditional design process; designers shift from research to rapid execution, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 终结了传统设计流程，设计师从研究转向快速执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers must become block-shaped generalists, not T-shaped; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 3 月：设计师应成为块状通才而非 T 型人才；优先招聘有潜力的新毕业生而非资深人士。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped, deep T specialist, and cracked new grad; taste alone insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和潜力新毕业生；仅靠品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; focus on work and users, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏，新工具先等 6 个月；聚焦工作与用户，而非炒作。

jennywen.en: Speed is not an improvement; 'everyone uses it' is not a design argument; unique value lies in ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年 5 月：速度不是改进；‘人人都在用’不是设计理由；独特价值在于与模糊性共处。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers, not just a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，我认为 RLHF 仍是最主流的微调技术，且安全是系统级属性，需要多层防护，而非仅模型本身。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; SFT provides most gains, while RL with verifiable rewards adds reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，我强调后训练中数据质量胜过算法，SFT 贡献主要性能，而基于可验证奖励的强化学习则带来推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and data contamination threaten reproducibility; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，我认为 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，但过度优化和数据污染威胁可复现性；开源模型落后闭源 6-9 个月。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese open models fill US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚持预训练缩放定律仍有效，但低垂果实已尽，收益转向后训练和推理扩展；中国开源模型填补了美国空白。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade, but sustainability is questionable; Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，我预测开源模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，但可持续性存疑；中国实验室擅长工程执行，而非范式创新。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning is the winning approach for autonomous driving, despite past skepticism.
kendall.zh: 端到端学习是自动驾驶的制胜方法，尽管过去曾遭质疑。

kendall.en: World models and diverse data enable generalization to unseen scenarios, key for safety.
kendall.zh: 世界模型和多样化数据使模型能够泛化到未见场景，这对安全至关重要。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型中的表征、推理和人机交互。

kendall.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis in the near term.
kendall.zh: 内置传感器的量产车将在短期内超越自动驾驶出租车。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 对于深度学习，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Product expansion should follow user workflow, not market size; focus on time-to-value and removing blockers.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，主张产品扩展应遵循用户工作流而非市场规模，注重缩短价值实现时间和消除采用障碍。

dylanfield.en: AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases; only 17% of designers see AI as a threat.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，指出 AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限，仅 17%的设计师视 AI 为威胁。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，强调品味、工艺和观点至关重要，AI 输出只是起点而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting; design becomes the new code, enabling visual-first PRs to production.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，认为画布上的直接操作优于提示词，设计成为新代码，实现视觉优先的拉取请求直达生产。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoids benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人可从汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems; we're in decade of agents, not year; vibe coding is gateway, not replacement.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我认为 LLM 像操作系统，我们处于智能体十年而非元年；Vibe coding 是入门而非替代。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出我们在召唤幽灵而非构建动物；LLM 的强化学习糟糕，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心可极小。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents are key; jagged intelligence persists; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我自去年 12 月起不再写代码，智能体成为关键；智能的锯齿状仍存，理解仍是人类瓶颈。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际使用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress; measuring AI capabilities is becoming a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 扩展推理模型将加速 AI 进展；衡量 AI 能力正成为瓶颈，基准测试滞后。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习即可，无需专门实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是对齐的关键工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，指出可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能 Scaling 的方法；反向传播并不解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety via control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；通过控制来确保安全反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能的核心，而下一个词预测缺乏实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; RL is learning from experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是从经验中学习，并指出学习“有利于学习的表征”是首要开放问题。

turley.en: Initially viewed ChatGPT as accidental success; now sees model as product requiring daily iteration and shipping fast.
turley.zh: 最初视 ChatGPT 为意外成功；现在认为模型即产品，需像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布。

turley.en: Chat is not the final interface; future AI will render its own UI and integrate into tools, like Windows after MS-DOS.
turley.zh: 聊天不是最终界面；未来 AI 将自绘界面并融入工具，如同 MS-DOS 之后的 Windows。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格流程，产品开发则全力加速。

turley.en: North star shifted to long-term retention; growth driven by friction removal, product investment, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、富交互的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型需无缝产品化。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not reach AGI; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上，因为从 80% 到 99.9% 的性能提升极其困难。仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现 AGI，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and can be gamed; real progress should be measured through deep human evaluations. Optimizing for engagement leads to 'slop'.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进展应通过深度人工评估来衡量。为追求参与度而优化会导致“垃圾内容”。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from. Final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。仅靠最终奖励是不够的。

edwinchen.en: Different frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping model behavior and progress. There will not be one model to rule them all; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 不同前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造了模型的行为和进展。不会有一个模型统治一切；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical. Doctors using AI may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy; safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断至关重要。医生使用 AI 时可能因锚定效应和谄媚而表现不如单独使用 AI；安全必须优先于准确性。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not just capability, is the bottleneck; coding leads AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非单纯能力是瓶颈；编程是 AI 进步的先导。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands achievable tasks dramatically.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我将强化学习视为新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性大幅扩展了可完成任务。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力是新石油。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest open challenges; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI adoption.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大未解难题；非洲可跳过遗留问题，在 AI 应用上实现跨越式发展。

nando.en: Emphasizes diversity, inclusion, and human skills like communication as essential for beneficial AI.
nando.zh: 始终强调多样性和包容性，以及沟通等人文技能对构建有益 AI 至关重要。

nando.en: Shifted from excitement about scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing safety and real-world deployment challenges.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的兴奋，转向 2026 年优先关注安全与现实部署挑战。

nando.en: Believes fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; encourages embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 始终相信根本性创新可来自任何地方；鼓励拥抱失败、简化问题。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张通过多样化的合成数据，小型语言模型也能强大；多元对齐尊重不同价值观。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI is a creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴；代码是唯一真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh experience; AI adoption is now expected.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应重工艺与意图而非流程；副项目可超越经验；采用 AI 已成常态。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，持续强调品牌作为招聘与差异化的战略武器，应尽早投入以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers autonomy and adapt process to problem.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆，赋予设计师自主权，并让流程适应问题而非套用模板。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback to maintain velocity and decisiveness.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，反对结构化设计评审，倾向有机反馈以保持速度与决断力。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; velocity trumps perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常优于数据驱动；速度胜过完美。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the main programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为 AI 进步的下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，我认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我指出定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents need root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体需进行根因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as vital as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business results.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents turn developers into operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体将开发者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business model challenges; consumer agents disrupt SEO; generalists outperform specialists with AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：现有企业面临商业模式挑战；消费级智能体颠覆 SEO；通才借助 AI 胜过专才。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but internal workings remain alchemical.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他相信 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来更智能的 AI，但承认神经网络内部机制如同炼金术，难以理解。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities; models should learn by acting.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会，并主张模型应通过行动学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展虽推动进步，但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; inference costs are low enough to skip task-specific models.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，且推理成本极低，高价值领域无需专用模型。

shazeer.en: AI's best applications are often unforeseen; safety requires engineering safeguards and human oversight.
shazeer.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 的最佳应用常出乎意料，安全需工程防护和人类监督，这一观点贯穿其访谈。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability worries.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；应专注技能培养而非能力研究担忧。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督和可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. External oversight and third-party testing needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐；需外部监管和第三方测试。
